يكتسحون (form VIII)
# يَكْتَسِحُونَ (yaktasiḥūna) /jak.ta.si.ħuː.na/: third-person masculine plural non-past active indicative of اِكْتَسَحَ (iktasaḥa)
# يُكْتَسَحُونَ (yuktasaḥūna) /juk.ta.sa.ħuː.na/: third-person masculine plural non-past passive indicative of اِكْتَسَحَ (iktasaḥa)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
